text:
Priya: quick heads-up — nightly perf CI flagged a regression on the overnight bench run. p95 up ~18% for small-batch (1.7B) compared to baseline. artifacts uploaded: https://redwood-internal/ci/3189991234/artifacts — can someone bisect when they get a minute? @Alex @Ben

ci-bot: [ALERT] nightly-perf-ci: p95 delta +18% (small-batch-1.7B). Run id=3189991234. Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/3189991234.

Alex: grabbing artifacts now. Priya — which commit was under test?

Priya: test matrix ran on commit 8e3f1d5 (main@2026-11-14). I re-ran previous nightly (7b2a0c9) and the delta shows up between those two. No infra noise in host metrics.

Ben: noted. Last week we landed a continuous-batcher micro-optimization + a small kv-cache TTL tweak. both touched runtime scheduler paths. Might be related.

Tess: I'm on call and repro'd locally with the nightly image. use this quick repro:```./bench/run_small_batch.sh --model 1.7B --warmups 200 --iters 500 --profile``` p95 shows tail spikes ~280-320ms, see attached flamegraphs in the artifacts.

Alex: running a quick A/B: disabling continuous batcher on the image to see if it regresses back. starting git bisect to narrow if needed: `git bisect start 8e3f1d5 7b2a0c9`

Priya: if the batcher flip shows improvement, we should revert the micro-opt and add a smoke test gating p95 for small-batch runs. Also check KVCACHE_DEFAULT_TTL change in the same PR.

Alex: quick experiment: built dev image with CONTINUOUS_BATCHER=0 and re-ran repro — p95 back to baseline (~<50ms delta). Looks like the batcher patch is the likely culprit.

Ben: I'll open a revert PR + add a unit/regression smoke that runs the small-batch harness in CI (low-cost sample) and fails on p95 delta >10%. Assigning to me to draft. :hammer_and_wrench:

Priya: thanks. tagging eng-releases for a fast-track patch window and leaving notes in the incident issue (#318999). Also adding a link to the failed artifacts and the quick remediation steps.

Tess: leaving the oncall handoff — if anyone needs me to run more traces, DM.

Alex: will finish bisect if needed and post exact commit that introduced the regression.

Ben: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321 — revert + smoke test. requesting review from @alex @priya.

Priya: great, thanks all. moving to follow-up channel for rollout scheduling. :white_check_mark:
